## Summary

Problem or requested outcome, who is affected, and why it matters.

## Evidence

For bugs: actual versus expected behavior, reproduction steps, relevant versions/environment and sanitized evidence, where available.
For proposals: supporting evidence and assumptions. Mark unknowns; proposed checks are not completed validation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Observable outcomes that would resolve this work item.

## Scope And Constraints

Included work, non-goals, dependencies/canonical links, relevant compatibility or release target, and decisions needed.
